description: $0.02 USDC on Solana per report check - the payment buys one signed correspondence report grading the report's typed claims against the submitted transcript and evidence: Class A claims PRESENT / ABSENT / FOUND-AS-VARIANT; Class B claims PRESENT-AND-MATCHING / PRESENT-BUT-DIFFERS (field named) / ABSENT. Counts per type only; no composite score.
